conf.description: OpenShift kube-apiserver/openshift-apiserver audit via OTLP logs (Technology Preview): body is the same audit.k8s.io/v1 Event as the json feed, so extract and nest it; per recommendations.direct.cribl the typed k8s.audit.event.* attributes are redundant duplicates and are intentionally not mapped (see README).

conf.comment: OpenShift kube-apiserver audit via OTLP (Tech Preview). Per catalog recommendation the elegant parse ignores the promoted k8s.audit.event.* attributes entirely - the logRecord body is byte-for-byte the same audit Event the json feed carries. Extract body, nest under kubernetes.audit, keep only lightweight resource identity for routing.
